summary:
Implementation plan for full-fledged nutritional feature parity on recipe cards and weekly planner meal slots:
- 5-slot architecture (Pre-breakfast, Breakfast, Lunch, Snack, Dinner) supporting multiple items per slot with individual X removal, slot clearing, and quick-add.
- Color-coded inline macro telemetry (Calories, Protein in emerald, Carbs in cyan, Fat in coral) on every recipe card item.
- Comprehensive daily nutrition footer with total calories, multi-segment macro distribution bar, and dedicated Protein, Carbs, Fat, and Fiber metric cards.
- Weekly summary analytics strip featuring Planned Meals progress, Average Daily Calories, Protein, Carbs, Fat, and Fiber.
- Type definitions and recipe constants upgraded to track dietary fiber.
